prompts.characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character illustration atlas for a classic East Asian 2D MMO GUI, not a sprite animation sheet. Generate one transparent PNG atlas with an exact 4-column by 2-row regular grid, square cells, preferably 2048 by 2048. Seven original full-body standing character illustrations, eighth cell empty transparent. Each person fully contained inside their cell, boots near 94% cell height and top of hair at 5%, face centered x=50%, face center y=15%; clear faces. Same scale and consistent late-1990s / early-2000s hand-painted East Asian historical MMO illustration style, ink outlines, rich shaded fabric, dignified expressive anime-adjacent faces, realistic adult proportions, not chibi, not 3D renders. Cell ordering left to right: top row 1 young adult male traveling merchant, black hair topknot, teal hanfu, leather satchel and curved sword; 2 stocky male iron guard, aged bronze armor, shield and spear; 3 adult male matchlock gunner, dark brown travel coat, headband and matchlock firearm; 4 young adult female lightning sorceress, blue embroidered robe, long black hair and staff. Bottom row 1 adult female physician white and sage robes, medicine case; 2 adult female Taoist support mage golden ochre robe and ritual scroll; 3 adult female red-robed talisman exorcist, long dark hair, fan and paper talismans; 4 empty. No labels, no numbers, no borders, no ground shadows, no scenery, no UI, no extra figures. Genuinely transparent background. Designed to be used both as full-body UI standees and cropped independent eye portraits. Must be beautiful standalone 2D character art, NOT reused combat sprites.
prompts.skin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production GUI sprite atlas for a vintage East Asian historical merchant MMO inspired by the Gersang interface in the supplied screenshots. Output exact regular 4 by 4 grid of square cells, 1024x1024 or higher square size, no gutters. Transparent outside separate motifs. Extremely detailed hand-painted raster game assets, weathered grey stone, tarnished silver, cream-gold bevels, fine grain and worn etched corners. Not modern flat vector icons, not clean brown UI, no rounded modern cards. 16 cells row-major. Row0: (0) square grey-stone nine-slice panel background with thin double raised pale silver/beige rectangular bevel border, dark grey mottled interior, clean straight geometry; (1) square recessed classic toolbar button frame in aged bronze and silver with empty dark inset; (2) thick silver stone circular minimap ring, transparent circle center and transparent outside, no map content; (3) unframed flat grey-stone mottled tile texture for GUI fill. Row1: (0) wooden chest/backpack inventory icon; (1) old scroll with a small character silhouette stats icon; (2) folded parchment quest log icon; (3) two gold-clad merchant busts guild icon. Row2: (0) two friendly human busts friends icon; (1) embossed question-mark help icon; (2) iron cogwheel settings icon; (3) unfolded green parchment world-map icon. Row3: (0) curved saber battle-power icon; (1) old brown book credit icon; (2) three gold ingots currency icon; (3) bright green square with a small white plus, classic unspent-stat-points marker. Keep every motif centered in its cell and fully inside that cell. The panel's corners must support native nine-slice scaling, no text embedded. No branding, no watermark, no additional symbols.
prompts.map: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game cartographic atlas background, square 1536 or 2048 PNG. A top-down hand-painted geographic drawing for a classic East Asian historical MMORPG world map and circular minimap. Inspired by original Gersang map palettes: deep dark blue textured water, sandy ochre coastal shelves, dense green forest dotted like old pixel terrain, brown mountainous ridges. Show a broad mainland with forest and mountains, winding rivers, coastal bay on the right and several offshore islands, small town landmarks, volcanic terrain in upper-right, an old walled city in middle-right and dark cavern hills toward bottom. View exactly from above, flat cartography, not perspective or an isometric battlefield screenshot. Detailed raster artwork suitable for shrinking into a small circular map. No labels, no words, no numbers, no borders, no people, no character icons, no modern satellite imagery. This is original art for a fictional playable local prototype; no fabricated geographic labels. Palette and old-game density should evoke the reference map screenshots.

reference: Seven user-supplied Gersang screenshots: layout and vintage grey-stone / silver material reference; not copied original game assets.
limits: Original redrawn art; no claim of pixel-identical 100 percent reproduction. Painted map labels correspond to prototype coordinates, not a completed country world.
